REVIEW BLOCKER (synckit finder pass, CONFIRMED) + DECISION CORRECTION. The ratified "Background → ProcessType Background" mapping for helpers reintroduced the darwinbg CPU-starvation bug synckit fixed six days prior (650f3f5, CHANGELOG.md:152-156: the darwinbg clamp starved helper subprocess probes past bounded deadlines — "run ioreg: signal: killed") — for the same consumer, reposync, whose helper forks git/jj continuously; the new test even certified the regression. Corrected fleet decision: HELPER AGENTS CARRY NEITHER KEY — no LimitLoadToSessionType, no ProcessType — for every manifest session_type value; the manifest field stays declarative/validated only. Field-validated: home's hand-patched reposync helper plist (no session key, no process type) bootstrapped over SSH first-try and serves under real load. There was never an EIO/darwinbg tension — the EIO came from the session key alone; ProcessType was a gratuitous intent-preservation. Synckit lane is applying the correction (delete helperProcessType; six-value table asserts BOTH keys absent from Agent and rendered plist, restoring the lost darwinbg regression coverage). Other repos unaffected — their diffs only drop Aqua keys and add nothing.

Two review notes recorded for follow-ups: (1) cookiesync's helper set Aqua for Keychain/Touch-ID; keyless agents in gui/<uid> still run in the GUI session (local capt-hook GUI helper runs keyless now), but the cookiesync cutover should verify Touch-ID consent explicitly — noting on synckit 3886b75. (2) bundledExecutable recognizes only Contents/MacOS; other bundle-executable shapes (Contents/Helpers, LoginItems, .appex/.xpc) would byte-stage — forward-looking, no current consumer, same task. Reviews complete so far: cc-notes CLEAN (digest honesty proven by single-field flip-and-rehash), synckit = this blocker + otherwise clean (seam identity confirmed byte-for-byte; all new tests discriminate).
